call_purpose: You wanted to find out why new leads from your funnel form had stopped reaching your CRM.

resolved.text: We found a typo in your webhook URL, you corrected and saved it, and your test lead now shows up in your CRM.

support_next_steps.text: We will re-index the webhook queue, have our technical team resend the missed leads to your CRM, and message you once that is done.
